title: chore(i18n): delete 92 message keys nothing reads from all ten locale packs
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9SgBCUABMtPXuje9dvRBdof)_

Part of #25921 (the dead i18n keys slice; the card's other items stay open there).

Clause-②: no (only unused message keys go; no exported type or runtime contract changes)
Metadata-protocol: none

## What

Deletes 92 message keys that nothing reads from all ten locale packs under `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/` (`ar`, `de`, `en`, `es`, `fr`, `ja`, `ko`, `pt`, `ru`, `zh`). Pure deletions: no key is renamed or added, and no value changes. Each pack loses the same 92 leaves (`en` shows 93 deleted lines because `publicForm.unavailableDescription` spans two).

Two test ratchets that name keys follow the deletion in the same PR:

- `ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/objectView-config-keys-retired-4730.test.ts`: `console.objectView.ufTabs` and `viewTypeUnavailableShort` move from the surviving half (105 to 103) to the retired list (124 to 126). The total stays 229, and the retired list now pins both keys absent from every pack.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/product-specific.allowlist.json`: `workspace.invite` and `workspace.members` are deleted from the live list, as its own test asks ("a migrated one is deleted from the live list"). The list takes deletions only, and this is one.

## How each key was proved unused

Measured on `origin/main` `6d15acab` (objectstack-ai/objectstack), with three searches per key:

1. `node ui/scripts/check-i18n-dead-keys.mjs --json`: every key below is in its CONFIRMED tier (no `t()` / `tt()` call site, no dynamic template head that reaches it, no indirect one-hop template, and no key-boundary textual occurrence of the dotted key or its property chain anywhere in `ui/`). The run reported 3,879 pack keys, 398 candidates, 122 CONFIRMED, 276 NEEDS-REVIEW, `wrongVerdicts: []` and `classFourUncovered: []`.
2. A whole-repository search, wider than the tool's `ui/` scope: `git grep -n -F -f KEYS -- . ':!ui/packages/i18n/src/locales'`, then a filter that keeps a hit only where the key is bounded on both sides by a character that cannot continue a dotted key. Result: 0 hits for all 92 keys. The one raw line it printed is `object-grid.rowHeight` in a `packages/spec` comment, a component name and not `grid.rowHeight`. Positive control: the same search for `preview.changes.typeCount.object` finds `DraftChangesPanel.tsx`.
3. A read of the subtree and dynamic pack readers the tool reports but cannot tier (its classes 1 and 5): `LoadingScreen.tsx` spreads `console.error` but reads only `connectionFailed` and `checkServer`; `outboundAgentText.ts` indexes `console.ai` only by its four `OutboundAgentTextKey` names; `flowResponse.ts` reads only `form.noPermissionToSave`. None of them reads a deleted key. A probe for template heads (a template literal or a string concatenation that starts with the key's parent namespace) over all non-test source in `ui/packages`, `ui/apps`, `ui/examples` and `ui/e2e` found one, a `table.` template inside an error message in `ui/packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts`, which is refusal text and not a translation lookup.

After the change the tool reports 3,787 pack keys, 30 CONFIRMED (the 30 kept on purpose, listed below) and the same 276 NEEDS-REVIEW, so the deletion moved no key into either tier.

### The 92 deleted keys

- `appDesigner`: `addComponent`, `aggregate`, `appearance`, `colorVariant`, `componentProperties`, `createApp`, `editApp`, `fields`, `livePreview`, `modeCode`, `modePreview`, `navBuilder`, `rowHeight`, `selectObjects`, `showFilters`, `showSearch`, `showSort`, `toolbar`, `valueField`, `viewType`
- `console.ai`: `conversationReady`, `preparingConversation`, `workspaceSubtitle`, `workspaceTitle`
- `console.commandPalette`: `createApp`
- `console.error`: `serverUnreachable`, `timeout`
- `console.objectView`: `ufTabs`, `viewTypeUnavailableShort`
- `console`: `title`
- `dashboard`: `addWidget`, `editLayout`, `resetLayout`, `saveLayout`
- `errors`: `networkError`, `notFound`, `serverError`, `timeout`
- `form`: `deleteSuccess`, `invalidFormat`, `removeItem`, `saveSuccess`
- `grid`: `rowHeight`
- `home`: `allApps`, `createFirstApp`, `title`, `welcomeDescription`
- `home.gettingStarted`: `cta`, `title`
- `kanban`: `deleteCard`, `deleteColumn`
- `layout.appSwitcher`: `addApp`, `editApp`, `editNavigation`, `home`, `manageAllApps`, `noAppsConfigured`, `systemConsole`
- `publicForm`: `consentLabelDefault`, `consentLink`, `retry`, `secureNotice`, `submitAnother`, `tryDemo`, `unavailableDescription`, `unavailableTitle`
- `report`: `allLabel`, `columnTotal`, `columnsLabel`, `emptyLabel`, `failedToLoad`, `grandTotal`, `needsAcross`, `rowTotal`, `rowsLabel`
- `sidebar`: `scope`, `settings`
- `table`: `collapseRow`, `expandRow`, `exportExcel`, `filterColumn`, `freezeColumn`, `showing`, `unfreezeColumn`
- `user`: `settings`
- `validation`: `type`
- `view`: `activeFilters`, `activeSort`, `saveAsView`, `unsavedChanges`
- `workspace`: `invite`, `members`

## Kept although the tool lists them CONFIRMED (30)

- **28 plural forms.** `preview.changes.typeCount.{object,view,page,dashboard,app,action,report,flow,permission,agent,email_template}_one` / `_other`, `notifications.arrivalMany_one` / `_other`, `notifications.arrivalRepeats_one` / `_other`, `fields.relativeDate.overdue_one` / `_other`. Their base keys are called with `count` (`DraftChangesPanel.tsx`, `useInboxArrivalNotifier.ts`, `core/src/utils/date-display.ts`), so i18next reads exactly these suffixed forms. The tool expands plural suffixes only for call sites it classifies as pack calls; these call sites reach the base key through a passed-in translator, so the base key lands in NEEDS-REVIEW and its suffixed forms fall to CONFIRMED. Deleting them would turn every count string on those screens back to the bare fallback.
- **`console.ai.agentLabels.dataChat` and `metadataAssistant`.** No code reads them (`AiChatPage.tsx` maps only `ask` and `build`), but the pack marks them "Legacy keys kept for back-compat with any external overrides". Dropping them is a separate call.

## Acceptance notes

- `ui/scripts/check-i18n-dead-keys.mjs` false-positive class, not fixed here: the plural forms of a base key that is called with `count` through a translator the AST pass does not classify as a pack call are reported CONFIRMED. 28 of today's 122 CONFIRMED entries (23%) are this class. Carrier: none.
- `ui/scripts/check-i18n-dead-keys.mjs`'s text footprint does not see a key that a JSON list spells as namespace plus leaf (`product-specific.allowlist.json`): `workspace.invite` and `workspace.members` were CONFIRMED while that list named them. Carrier: none.
- The pack objects' TypeScript types (`typeof en`, `TranslationKeys`) lose the deleted members. Nothing in this repository reads one of them by property (search 2 above covers the property chains too, and the tool's property-chain leg found none); an external host that does would see a type error. Recorded here because the claim line says no exported type changes.
- `scripts/sdui-manifest.sources/i18n.json` is re-recorded (`node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` after merging `main` at `a335f1de`), because `@object-ui/i18n` is in the console registry closure; `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` is green on the pushed head. The i18n packs are serialised: #26045, #26040, #26044, #26048 and #26055 land first, and #26040 also edits these packs. When its turn comes this branch merges `main` again, re-records the digest and rebuilds the Console; the seat enqueues it. It is not armed or queued from here.

Local test runs and gate readings are in the `os-dev-report` comment on #25921.
